ActionDescriptions.ToDebugEchoValidatedPromptStringBinding:

ActionDescriptions.ToGenerateWorkflowReportNarrativeSkill:
to summarize a workflow run report
Generate a human-readable narrative summary from a buffaly.workflowRunReport.v1 JSON document without changing deterministic workflow status.
ActionDescriptions.ToGenerateWorkflowReportNarrativeValidat:
to validate a workflow report narrative summary
Generate and validate a narrative summary from a buffaly.workflowRunReport.v1 JSON document while treating the JSON as the source of truth.
ActionDescriptions.ToInspectValidatedPromptActionDefinition:
to inspect a validated prompt action definition
validatedPromptActionName - prototype name for one ValidatedPromptAction. Returns resolution details for debugging deployed validated prompt definitions.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunValidatedPromptSkill:
to execute a validated prompt action
validatedPromptActionName - prototype name for one ValidatedPromptAction. userInput - input for the work prompt. maxAttempts - maximum validation attempts. Child session selection is controlled by the ValidatedPromptAction.ChildSessionScope setting and defaults to per-parent; this action intentionally does not expose raw child session keys.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunValidatedPromptSkillFromSessionFile:
to execute a validated prompt action using a staged input file
validatedPromptActionName - prototype name for one ValidatedPromptAction. userInputRelativePath - file path under the current session directory containing the full user input. maxAttempts - maximum validation attempts. Child session selection is controlled by the ValidatedPromptAction.ChildSessionScope setting and defaults to per-parent; this action intentionally does not expose raw child session keys.
ActionDescriptions.ToSummarizeTextInOneSentenceSkill:
to summarize text in exactly one faithful sentence
Summarize provided text in exactly one faithful sentence without adding facts.
